movie: For an evolution sequence, first follow temperature at fixed camera angle and uniform physical-time cadence (first half of frames); then hold the last saved state and orbit once through the four fields, starting in temperature. A single-state turntable retains its periodic field cycle. Dissolves blend registered images in linear light, never physical fields.

style.display_note: Smooth illustrative opacity; native samples unchanged. Fixed physical reference length. Beta >= 100, including B=0 (infinite beta), saturates to amber.
style.notes: Fixed log scales across products. Temperature uses a luminance-ordered cool-blue to warm-amber ramp with a faint nonzero hot-phase opacity. Beta uses the actual Reverse(managua) RGB values from production/apj_style.jl: low beta blue, high beta amber. Opacity is illustrative, never physical absorption. Ohmic and viscous heating share the same inferno ramp, log10 range [-29,-22], and opacity curve for direct comparison of saved volumetric rates.
